751-3286-6633.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-851-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2066-2348-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Cast Fertile Ground by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to that land creature.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2066-2348-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

38-2173-5220-7192.description:
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying its mana cost.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3215-3967-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

57-969-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-969-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-4050-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1286-2292-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-2292-5972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

648-5087-5879.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive and The Ozolith.
648-5087-5879.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill a creature before your combat phase.
648-5087-5879.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Kill the Fractal, triggering The Ozolith, moving the Fractal's counters onto The Ozolith.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving its counters onto Walking Archive.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, and thus losing the game.

1077-5571-6798--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

301-1099-2646.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

856-2099-2267-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

3490-3910-4017-5296-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
3490-3910-4017-5296-6441.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2438-2527-4073-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2438-2527-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

3661-5220-5256-5683.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

366-1621-2781.description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel.
When it ETBs, target Felidar Guardian with its ETB and trigger Purphoros, God of the Forge.
When Felidar Guardian ETBs, target Wispweaver Angel and trigger Purphoros, God of the Forge.
Repeat for Infinite damage.

738-1202-1969-5256.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Altar of Dementia.
Myr Moonvessel and Grave Pact trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Grave Pact's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
